definition: ἐμ-πορεύομαι  depon.  (ἔμπορος), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר ;] __1. to travel, esp. for business.  __2. to traffc, trade: Jas.4:13.  __3. C. accusative of thing(s)  __(a) to traffic in;  __(b) to import: (Hos.12:1, for יָבַל hoph.).  __4. C. accusative of person(s), to make a gain of: 2Pe.2:3.† (AS)
